sentences.text: No; the RBI KFS APR illustration for this product shows 17.07%, not 12%.
The documents do not state that this product’s KFS APR figure is 12%.

The KFS for Loans & Advances (2024) is no longer in force on 2026-11-23, and the in-force UCB directions require the KFS to include a computation sheet of APR and say APR shall include all charges which are levied by a UCB.
